lean.rule_text: Model lean: the side that both the desk model and DraftKings' no-vig price make the favourite (each at least 55%), priced no shorter than -300; the one game per day where the lower of the two probabilities is highest. Not a proven edge: at DraftKings' own no-vig probability the expected value is the book's margin.

backtest.note: 1u per lean at the DraftKings close, one per game day. A favourite-only rule: the record is expected to sit near the book's margin over time, whatever a short run shows.

qb_model.method: Logistic model on walk-forward Elo + QB edge (ANY/A per dropback, 250-dropback prior toward replacement level, vs the team's last-8-starts average, x 35 dropbacks), fitted on last season with the actual starter. Live: projected starter from the last start / regular + ESPN's injury report; an uncertain QB situation blocks the pick.

avail_model.method: Logistic model on walk-forward Elo + abnormal value missing (Game Score per minute above replacement x expected minutes of roster players not playing, minus the team's own running average, away minus home) + back-to-back rest, fitted on last season only with the players who actually appeared. Live: ESPN's injury report (Out = out, Day-To-Day = half); a game with a material Day-To-Day player is not picked.
beta_labels: per Game Score point of abnormal value missing (away - home)
avail_model.constants_chosen_on: 2025-26 season only (split-half CV); this season looked at once, 2026-11-11
avail_model.finding_2026_11_11: On last season the availability terms cut log loss 0.599 -> 0.585. On this season's DK-priced games the model is NOT better than Elo alone and far from the DraftKings close; the verdict stays NO EDGE.
